inclusion_note: Contains the named field Myocardial Infarction (MI), which stays a separate comparator.

Narrowest heading that contains preterm-birth complications, birth asphyxia, neonatal sepsis and neonatal jaundice. Over-inclusion: hereditary conditions filed under this heading, above all Cystic Fibrosis (tree number C16.614.213), also Ichthyosis and Severe Combined Immunodeficiency.
Named field STROKE; cells are shared with the registered families, not queried again.

COVID-19 (D000086382, introduced 2021, applied back to 2020) is a child of Pneumonia, Viral. The exploded Pneumonia heading therefore contains the COVID-19 literature from 2020 on, although GBD counts COVID-19 as a separate cause and COVID is a named field of this study. Removing it keeps the series comparable before and after 2020. Under-inclusion: bronchiolitis and acute bronchitis are not covered. Records on other pneumonia that also carry the COVID-19 heading are lost.
Named field DM; cells are shared with the registered families, not queried again.

Symptom heading. Over-inclusion: non-infectious diarrhoea (for example drug-induced). Under-inclusion: records indexed only under a pathogen-specific heading (for example cholera or rotavirus infections).
Under-inclusion: records indexed only under the separate heading Depression (symptom or behaviour) are not included (MeSH annotation: do not confuse with DEPRESSION).
History note 2008 (1963): the heading was named Abnormalities until 2007; it exists for the whole study window.
Over-inclusion: hearing loss of every cause, including causes that GBD assigns elsewhere.
Under-inclusion: tracheal neoplasms are not covered. Over-inclusion: malignant mesothelioma (a separate GBD cause) and pulmonary nodules are filed under this heading.
Over-inclusion: secondary headache disorders. Under-inclusion: records indexed only under the symptom heading Headache.

gbd_cause: Cirrhosis and other chronic liver diseases
inclusion_note: Core entity of the cause. Under-inclusion: chronic liver disease without cirrhosis (for example fatty liver disease, chronic hepatitis, alcoholic liver disease other than cirrhosis).
The parent heading Iron Deficiencies also covers iron deficiency without anaemia.
Named field COVID; cells are shared with the registered families for its registered year window 2020 to 2024, not queried again. The heading was introduced in 2021 and is applied back to 2020.

Broader: the general heading for diseases of the female genital tract (annotation: general, prefer specifics; history note: was GYNECOLOGIC DISEASES 1965-78). Its narrower headings were not read on 2026-10-08; which of them GBD assigns to other causes is to be checked in the MeSH Browser.
